hook: Every permit in your city is public. Nobody reads them.
caption: Every deck, addition and new home in your area gets a permit first. Pegasus reads all of them every morning and ranks the ones that fit your trade. You call first.

hook: 5 jobs that were filed yesterday near you
caption: Slide 1: hook. Slides 2-5: real anonymized permits from this week (street only), with job type + value. Slide 6: 'Get these with addresses every morning.'
cta: Get the free weekly permit report

hook: Your next listing is already on file at the courthouse.
caption: Tax liens, probate filings, code violations and 20-year owners with 70% equity. All public. Pegasus stacks them into one score so you know who's likely to sell this year, without guessing.

hook: A new house permit means 14 different trades get hired.
caption: Framing week 1-6. Roof week 5-10. HVAC, plumbing, electric week 6-12. Deck, fence and landscaping in year one. Pegasus tells each trade when it's their turn.

hook: Free tip: how to find new construction before the GC hires out
caption: Search your county's open data portal for 'building permits'. Filter work type = New, use = residential. Sort by date. That's your list. (Or let Pegasus do it every morning.)
cta: No link in groups; reply with link if asked

hook: Shared leads are a race to the bottom.
caption: Paying $80 for a lead that 4 other contractors also bought isn't marketing. It's a lottery ticket. Public permit data is free, it's first, and almost nobody uses it.

hook: How investors find off-market deals without driving for dollars
caption: Tax delinquent + absentee owner + 20 years owned + high equity. Pegasus stacks the signals and ranks owners by motivation. Then the deal analyzer gives you ARV and max offer in 5 seconds.

hook: Storm last night? Roofers already have the map.
caption: Pegasus pulls NOAA hail and wind reports and matches them to your area within hours. Then the roofing jobs show up in your feed, scored.

hook: Lumber yards: you can see every project in your trade area.
caption: Every builder pulling permits, every new subdivision approved, every addition, in one feed for your reps. The first supply house in each market gets an exclusive data partnership.

hook: POV: you're the first deck builder to call.
caption: New homeowner, closed 4 months ago, backyard is bare. Pegasus predicted a deck at 35% likely. You called. They hadn't even started looking.

hook: 6 public records that predict a home sale
caption: 1 Probate filing 2 Tax delinquency 3 Pre-foreclosure notice 4 Expired listing 5 Long ownership + high equity 6 Code violations on a rental. Pegasus scores all six.

hook: Likely-to-sell, explained in one sentence.
caption: Property facts and public records in, probability of listing in the next 12 months out. No demographics, ever. Fair-housing safe by design.

hook: I tested 'buying leads' vs public permits for 30 days.
caption: Script 05: side-by-side cost per job. Shared leads: $X per job (use your real numbers). Permits via Pegasus: first call every time.

hook: Free tip: your county posts its delinquent tax list every year
caption: Most treasurers publish it as a PDF or spreadsheet. Cross it with absentee owners and you have a call list. (Pegasus does this automatically and updates it weekly.)

hook: The new-home sequence, trade by trade
caption: Concrete → framing → roof → HVAC/plumbing/electric → insulation → drywall → flooring/paint → cabinets → deck/fence/landscape. Know your window.

hook: Behind the scenes: how Pegasus reads 10,000 permits a day
caption: Screen demo: radar map filling up, the Morning Drop arriving, swipe right to save. 30 seconds.

hook: Founding members: 40% off. For life.
caption: First 100 customers keep 40% off as long as they stay. Counter on the site shows what's left.

hook: Pools legally need a fence.
caption: Every pool permit is a fence lead 15-120 days out. That's the kind of thing Pegasus predicts. Fence companies: you're welcome.

hook: Expired listings are the warmest cold call in real estate.
caption: Connect your MLS and every expired, withdrawn or cancelled listing in your farm becomes a lead the minute it changes status, private to you.

hook: Weekly recap: what Pegasus found in Virginia Beach this week
caption: Data post generated from live numbers: permits by type, top streets, total value. (Use `pegasus marketing weekly-posts`.)

hook: Why we built Pegasus
caption: Founder story: a contractor in Hampton Roads who got tired of buying shared leads and started reading permits instead. Honest, short, first person.

hook: Roofers: 3 signals that a roof is about to be replaced
caption: Hail in the swath. House built 20+ years ago. New owner in the last 6 months. Pegasus scores all three.

hook: Question for remodelers: when do new owners actually remodel?
caption: Our data says most kitchen and bath projects start 2-18 months after a sale. When do you see it? (Genuine discussion post.)

hook: Your farm, as a heat map.
caption: Turnover rate, absentee share, hottest streets, and a branded monthly market report you can send to every door.

hook: Pegasus in 60 seconds
caption: The full product video: pick trade + area → radar → Morning Drop → swipe → AI brief → win. End card: founding offer.

hook: Electricians: you're hired in week 6 of every new home.
caption: Plus every panel upgrade, solar install, EV charger and generator permit. Pegasus sends them all, scored.

hook: The best lead is the one nobody else has called yet.
caption: That's the whole product.

hook: Wholesalers: run a deal in 5 seconds
caption: Deal analyzer demo: ARV from comps, repair estimate, 70% MAO, grade A-F. Then unlock owner contact (DNC flagged).

hook: Exclusive ZIPs: one trade, one company, one ZIP.
caption: Lock your best ZIP code so no other Pegasus customer in your trade gets those leads. First come, first served.

hook: Free download: 2026 permit report for Hampton Roads
caption: Counts by trade and city, top builders by starts, busiest ZIPs. Free, no email required (link in comments when allowed).

hook: Kitchen & bath pros: the 18-month window
caption: After a home sells, the new owner remodels within 18 months. Pegasus flags every sale in your area and predicts the kitchen.

hook: We don't use demographics. Here's what we use instead.
caption: Ownership length, equity, absentee status, distress filings, recent permits, turnover. Fair-housing safe and explainable.

hook: A demolition permit is a new-home permit in 3-9 months.
caption: Builders and framers: watch the teardowns.

caption: Launch video (script 12). Founding seats left: use the live number.

caption: Pegasus is open to everyone in Hampton Roads today, and to any US county through Source Scout.
